The '''2020–21 Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball team''' represented [[Mississippi State University]] during the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The team was led by sixth-year head coach [[Ben Howland]], and played their home games at [[Humphrey Coliseum]] in [[Starkville, Mississippi]] as a member of the [[Southeastern Conference]]. In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], they finished the season 18–15, 8–10 in [[2020–21 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish in ninth place. They defeated [[2020–21 Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball team|Kentucky]] in the second round of the [[2021 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] before losing to [[2020–21 Alabama Crimson Tide men's basketball team|Alabama]] in the quarterfinals. They received an invitation to the [[2021 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]] as the fourth seed in the Saint Louis bracket. There they defeated [[2020–21 Saint Louis Billikens men's basketball team|Saint Louis]],<ref>{{Cite web|title=Mississippi State vs. Saint Louis - Game Recap - March 20, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401311780|access-date=2021-09-29|website=ESPN.com|language=en}}</ref> [[2020–21 Richmond Spiders men's basketball team|Richmond]],<ref>{{Cite web|title=Mississippi State vs. Richmond - Game Recap - March 25, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/401311781|access-date=2021-09-29|website=ESPN.com|language=en}}</ref> and [[2020–21 Louisiana Tech Bulldogs basketball team|Louisiana Tech]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=Louisiana Tech vs. Mississippi State - Game Summary - March 27, 2021 - ESPN|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/game/_/gameId/401311786|access-date=2021-09-29|website=ESPN.com|language=en}}</ref> to advance the championship game where they lost to [[2020–21 Memphis Tigers men's basketball team|Memphis]].

==Previous season==
The [[2019–20 Mississippi State Bulldogs men's basketball team|Bulldogs]] finished the [[2019–20 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 20–11, 11–7 in [[2019–20 Southeastern Conference men's basketball season|SEC play]] to finish in a tie for fourth place. They were set to be the No. 4 seed in the [[2020 SEC men's basketball tournament|SEC tournament]] with a bye to the quarterfinals. However, the SEC Tournament<ref>{{Cite web|title=2020 SEC Tournament canceled Thursday amid coronavirus pandemic concerns|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/2020-sec-tournament-canceled-thursday-amid-coronavirus-pandemic-concerns/live/|access-date=2021-09-29|website=CBSSports.com|language=en}}</ref> and all other postseason tournaments were canceled due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic.<ref>{{Cite web|title=2020 NCAA Tournament canceled due to growing threat of coronavirus pandemic|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/2020-ncaa-tournament-canceled-due-to-growing-threat-of-coronavirus-pandemic/|access-date=2021-09-29|website=CBSSports.com|language=en}}</ref>
